primary_multiplicity: Holm8 within each question; Holm24 also reported
member_multiplicity: Holm across all primary explicit-colon member/label Q1 tests; within-domain Holm also shown; experts receive simultaneous bootstrap max-deviation bands
bootstrap: 2000 shared whole-scene multinomial draws; 95% percentile intervals of raw statistic, not null-adjusted causal effects
Q1: equal average of within-category TV(f conditional route mass versus category load) over unique fixed(feature,label) roles: shared both labels, A_bias in A, B_bias in B
Q2: equal shared-feature mean TV of its route-mass profile between A/B; conditional null preserves category route baselines
Q3: TV between equal-feature mean profiles of A-biased candidates on A tokens and B-biased candidates on B tokens
global_permutation: whole16scene blocks plus one common24label permutation; independently reorder3family slots per scene, shared across all labels/wordings; then pair with fixed feature rows
conditional_permutation: whole scene blocks within frozen length bins, category roles fixed; three-family slot permutations shared across labels/wordings
length_rule: DEV scene mean prefix length median; CONF bins assigned from this cutoff, merge to one bin if any bin has fewer4scene blocks; report if length matching is lost
random_matching: 1000 frozen no-replacement sets from DEV/reference-only candidate pools; empirical control distributions are descriptive, not calibrated randomization p-values
effect_rule: 5 percentage-point TV is only a pre-outcome display screen; no scientific utility threshold
missing: zero occurrence -> NA; no zero filling; each estimate reports observed/eligible coverage; insufficient behavior remains descriptive
